dedupe_keys.name: nevada solar one wind and collector structural loads

description: The National Renewable Energy Laboratory publishes wind and structural-load measurements from the operating Nevada Solar One concentrating-solar plant. Meteorological masts and load sensors cover four parabolic-trough rows, with additional lidar scans over the collector field. The 2021–2023 data use daily Parquet files organised by measurement type, year, month and day. Masts and loads have 20 Hz and one-minute products, while lidar files follow individual scans. Public S3 access is free under CC BY 4.0, with a documented Python demonstration. The measurements can validate wind-loading and collector-performance simulations alongside energy assessments with model-system-advisor-model-sam. A caveat is that one plant layout and collector design do not represent all solar installations. Measurement synchronisation, processing and missing periods matter when comparing extreme loads. No part of the approximately 324.6 GB archive was downloaded.
